Great dog grooming & shop. I was looking for nail trimming and anal glad extraction for my senior pups. Other places would not do this service without the bath. As dogs age the gland fluid becomes thicker which can cause bigger issues. Issues with glands are more common in smaller breeds. Do the glands monthly if possible!
